พิมพ์ help เพื่อดูรายการคำสั่ง
Fastboot commands:
Device:
devices List connected devices
getvar <name> Read a variable, e.g. getvar product
Flashing:
flash <partition> [file] Flash a file to a partition
erase <partition> Erase a partition
stage <file> Send a file to the device
set_active <slot> Switch the active slot (a/b)
System:
reboot [target] Reboot (system, bootloader, recovery, fastboot)
oem <args> Run an OEM command
flashing lock|unlock Lock or unlock the bootloader
Other:
clear Clear the screen
help Show this list
File: attach with + File, or type a full path.
